_meta.description: Fictional test dataset used to generate and compare EVERY PDF form. Not real people, vehicles, NIDs, TINs or phone numbers.
rules: All identifiers use obvious placeholder patterns (repeating/sequential digits).
Never replace these values with real customer data.
Field names follow the canonical names in docs/FORM_ANALYSIS.md.
coverage: English values; Latin text is upper-cased at render time (decision #2)
Mixed Bangla + English + Bangla digits in one value (seller present address)
Bangla-only witness (witness 2) to prove typed Bangla still renders correctly
Long seller address that must wrap across 3 dotted rows on Form 22
father_or_husband: seller prints father, buyer prints husband (decision #3)
Present address prints on Forms 20/21/22, permanent only on Owner Particulars (decision #4)
Optional fields left null (guardian_name, seller.spouse_name, previous_registration_number)
